newsitem.title: EGYPT: National Cement in sharp profits fall.
newsitem.headline: National Cement in sharp profits fall.

text.p: National Cement made an attributed profit of 3.9 million pounds ($1.1 million) in the financial year 1995/6, 93 percent down on 52.066 million in the previous year, an official source said on Saturday.
The financial years start on July 1.
The profit is equivalent to 0.056 pounds for each of the 68.8 million National Cement shares, which closed on the Egyptian stock exchange last week at 19.25 pounds a share.
The company is one of the few cement firms which has not undergone large-scale privatisation. The state continues to hold an overwhelming stake but a few shares are in private hands.
